title: Haymarket Killer Clown
description: Ride the balloon-filled elevator in the Haymarket building at night and a killer clown lunges out of the dark. He can't hurt you.
content: Found by xGarbett and posted on November 23, 2026. Inside the Haymarket building on the Vice Beach waterfront, an elevator full of balloons hides a scripted horror scare.

Reported steps: go to Haymarket at night, head for the lift lobby on the left and take the elevator that is full of balloons (one guide says it is the second elevator). The doors close, the balloons drop to the floor and carnival music starts playing.

Then the balloons drift back up to the ceiling, the lights flicker and the music turns eerie. When the lights go out, a clown with a bloody face and a blade lunges at you. Another blackout follows and he vanishes.

The clown cannot hurt you and there is no reward, it is purely a scare. One guide calls it a random event, so it may not trigger on every ride. Guides disagree on small details such as which lift to use, the weapon and the area name, so treat them as community reports.
author: xGarbett

title: Super Mario Invisible Block
description: A hidden block in the woods of Lummox County drops red J and green L caps for Jason and Lucia, a nod to Mario and Luigi.
content: Found by xGarbett and posted on November 23, 2026. Deep in the woods of Moreau in Lummox County, a ruined building at the Lawton Co. Paper Mill hides a secret block that rewards you with a pair of Mario and Luigi style caps.

Reported steps: head to the ruins by the river (at the Lawton Co. Paper Mill, near the Water Wheel Meditation spot), use the bong next to the graffiti wall and watch for the plume of smoke. A translucent question-block style cube then appears above you.
Hit the block from underneath. Jumping works for some players, while xGarbett had to shoot it instead. Out come a red cap with a J for Jason and a green cap with an L for Lucia.
Guides differ slightly on the exact steps and location names, so treat the details above as community reports until confirmed.
author: xGarbett

title: Arthur Morgan's Cowboy Hat
description: A yard sale outside a blue house on Orchard Avenue in Port Gellhorn sells a worn 'Genuine Cowboy Hat' for $35 that matches Arthur Morgan's iconic hat from Red Dead Redemption 2.
content: Once you progress to Chapter 2 and unlock Port Gellhorn, a dynamic yard sale event can spawn outside a light-blue house on Orchard Avenue, roughly two blocks south of Moses' auto shop and just north of the Gellhorn International Raceway. Look for floating balloons and 'Yard Sale!' signs along the roadside.

Resting on a guitar case atop an outdoor sofa toward the back of the yard sale is a 'Genuine Cowboy Hat' in worn brown leather, complete with the exact twisted rope band worn by Arthur Morgan in Red Dead Redemption 2. The homeowner remarks that she has no idea where the old hat originally came from.
Purchasing the hat for $35 permanently unlocks it in your wardrobe under the accessories tab, allowing both Jason and Lucia to wear Arthur's signature outlaw hat across Leonida.
author: IGN

title: Bigfoot / Skunk Ape
description: Spot the Skunk Ape feeding on a deer carcass in the Gullet Marsh swamps south of Lake Cottonmouth, then chase him to kick off a cryptic storyline.
content: Rockstar's decades-long Sasquatch tradition continues in Leonida's Grassrivers region with Florida's regional cryptid, the Skunk Ape (affectionately dubbed 'Mr. Mangrove'). Along the muddy backroads of Gullet Marsh just south of Lake Cottonmouth, players can hear a guttural growl and spot the huge, moss-covered creature hunched over a deer carcass.

Approaching the Skunk Ape causes him to bolt into the dense swamp while leaving a trail of noxious green fumes. Chasing him on foot leads to a bizarre human-shaped wooden effigy tied to a tree; breathing in the spores knocks Jason or Lucia unconscious and triggers a brief cutscene of massive hairy feet walking past.

The free-roam encounter connects to 'Skunk Apeology 101', a multi-part Strangers & Freaks questline started by calling cryptid hunter Kirk from flyers at The Rusty Anchor in Key Lento or Skeeter's Bar in Hamlet. Tracking down three swamp effigies and hunting the beast from a helicopter with a tranquilizer rifle culminates in a trippy spore hallucination and a final choice to spare or shoot Mr. Mangrove.
author: Sir_Albs

title: Gary the Gator
description: Visit Ms. Sharleen's yard sale across from Jason's house in Key Lento during Chapter 1 to meet and pet Gary the Gator, a chill alligator wearing a tiny cowboy hat.
content: Directly across the street from Jason Duval's starting safehouse in Key Lento, a missable Chapter 1 neighborhood yard sale takes place outside Ms. Sharleen's house, marked by roadside signs and balloons.

Lounging right in front of her lawn chair is Gary the Gator, a docile alligator sporting a miniature cowboy hat. Locking onto him gives prompts to say 'Hey Gary', brush him off, or pet him—which refills Jason's Focus meter just like petting a dog or cat, while Ms. Sharleen jokes that Gary still thinks the round sunglasses on her table belong to him.

Players can also pick up exclusive yard-sale clothing like the 'Gator Howling Moon' T-shirt. Be careful not to start a fight or harm Gary, however: causing chaos at the yard sale bursts open the nearby storage shed and unleashes Becky, a much larger and deadlier alligator.
author: ecto_fun

title: Dolores the Snake
description: Jason's pet corn snake Dolores appears lost after Chapter 1, but returning to the old safehouse reveals her alive under the stairs.
content: Throughout Chapter 1, Jason keeps a red-and-white patterned corn snake named Dolores inside a glass terrarium beside the kitchen counter of his Key Lento stilt house. Interacting with the enclosure once a day to feed Dolores a mouse plays a short animation and grants Jason a Focus stat boost.

During the climactic Chapter 1 finale 'Home Sweet Home', masked intruders attack Jason and Lucia, smashing the terrarium and setting the safehouse ablaze. Amid the chaos, Dolores can briefly be glimpsed slithering toward the door as the house burns down.

If you sneak back to the charred remains of the Key Lento property in Chapter 2 or later and check beneath the exterior stairs leading up to the workout deck, you will find Dolores alive and well, curled around a nest of eggs and baby snakes. Inspecting her triggers unique relief dialogue from Jason—while players can also loot Jason's intact $5,000 'Rainy Day Fund' from the burned bedroom upstairs.
author: herdeirakirijo

title: Giant Sperm Whale
description: Equip scuba gear and dive into the deep ocean trenches off the Leonida coast to encounter a massive living sperm whale.
content: Deep beneath the waves of the Atlantic Ocean off the eastern coast of Leonida and in the deep-water trenches surrounding Abismo Key, scuba-equipped players have documented encounters with a colossal living sperm whale—the largest marine animal in Grand Theft Auto VI.

Swimming out into the open ocean drop-offs northeast of Leonard County or off the outer Leonida Keys allows divers to spot the giant cetacean gliding alongside humpback whales and pods of dolphins near the sea floor.

Back on the shoreline, Rockstar also hid an interactive beached sperm whale carcass that nods to the infamous 1970 Oregon exploding whale incident: detonating explosives against the washed-up whale triggers a massive gory blast that exposes bricks of cocaine and a collectible meteorite fragment inside its stomach.
author: WastedClipsCom

title: Haunted Marbelle Hotel
description: Step through a self-opening stairwell door in Southern Crosstown's abandoned Marbelle Hotel to trigger glowing occult symbols and turn Vice City into Silent Hill.
content: Tucked away on NW 8th Street in Southern Crosstown—just off the interstate near the Nine1Nine nightclub and one block east of the Crosstown Pawn & Gun shop—stands the abandoned Marbelle Hotel. While the front entrance is boarded up behind a weathered "For Sale" sign, players can circle around to the back alley and slip through an unlocked rear door. Inside the ground floor sits a locked keypad safe, while the upper floors are littered with eerie mannequins, floor carvings warning intruders to "Take your leave, be banished, cast out thy!", the Death of Swallow: Purple Ratface collectible comic card, and a rusted lead pipe leaning beside a mannequin.

Ascending to the top floor triggers a full-blown supernatural event when the stairwell door swings open on its own. Stepping through causes the lights to flicker and die as disembodied whispers fill the audio and glowing red occult symbols bleed across the walls and ceiling. Reaching the rooftop reveals that all of Vice City has been plunged into a dense, suffocating fog. On the roof floor lies an Old Note marked with the circled six-digit combination 955214; returning downstairs and entering that code into the ground-floor safe immediately lifts the fog over the city and rewards you with cash, the Crowex Ambassador "Breakfast" Collectible Watch, and "The Truth Is Out There" achievement.

The entire encounter is a loving homage to Konami's classic survival horror franchise Silent Hill. From the signature lead pipe melee weapon and creeping psychological dread in an abandoned hotel to the unnatural fog blanketing the surrounding cityscape, Rockstar transforms a quiet block of northern Vice City into an unforgettable survival-horror set piece.
author: xGarbett

title: Secret Bunker and Tank
description: Unravel a multi-step Cold War presidential conspiracy that leads to a hidden keypad hatch in the woods northwest of Grassrivers.
content: One of Leonida's deepest Cold War conspiracy mysteries begins during the daytime at the Friends of Freedom memorial on Catalan Boulevard in eastern Downtown Vice City. Speaking with a veteran named José Bermúdez behind the monument and asking about the 1965 assassination of former President Joe S. Russo earns you the address to his Little Cuba apartment on NW 4th Avenue. Inside José's second-floor unit, bunker blueprints, a tape recording revealing Russo's birthday (January 3, 1917), and a photograph labeled "Sharktooth Island" point to the first underground facility in northeast Leonard County.

At Sharktooth Island, entering 010317 into the hidden concrete bunker keypad and restoring the power triggers a coded radio broadcast. Deciphering the transmission with the Protocol #2 desk document yields the safe combination 2975, unlocking President Russo's 1922 Pistol alongside a classified "Chiliad '62" photograph of Russo shaking hands with an extraterrestrial. Written on the back of the photo is the word "OBSESS," which translates into calculator digits (085355) for a second secret hatch hidden in the woods northwest of Grassrivers near Big Pine in Mariana County.

Punching 085355 into the keypad strapped to a tree trunk opens the concealed ground hatch into an abandoned IAA black site hangar. After climbing down the ladder, restoring the generator power, and pressing the red hangar control button, you gain access to the unique Cold War 556 Assault Rifle and the Hauners Ridgway military tank. Once unlocked, the tank permanently respawns inside the underground hangar whenever you return, tying Rockstar's decades-long Mount Chiliad alien lore directly into a Cold War presidential cover-up.
author: xGarbett

title: Sex Robot Warehouse
description: Crawl under a cracked garage shutter in Vice City's Decor District at night as Jason to stumble into a workshop of malfunctioning, hostile AI sex robots.
content: Hidden along NE 17th Street in Vice City's Decor District—just around the corner from the Decor District car park and northeast of the Stockyard Speedshop—is an unassuming industrial garage that hides a bizarre slice of sci-fi horror. To trigger the encounter, you must visit the warehouse at night while playing as Jason (bringing Lucia along as a companion unlocks unique horrified dialogue once you escape). When the conditions are met, the metal garage shutter will be cracked open slightly with neon light spilling onto the pavement and distorted robotic voices echoing from within.

Crawling beneath the shutter drops Jason into a dimly lit workshop filled with shipping crates and partially assembled, malfunctioning AI sex robots. Turning the corner triggers a chaotic jump-scare ambush as a legless male robot with oversized dildos for hands lunges onto Jason, calling him "daddy" and begging to be finished off while other wide-eyed androids crawl out of the shadows. You must rapidly mash the struggle button through multiple Quick-Time Events to hurl the hostile bots off and fight your way back out—failing the prompts results in a fatal ambush.

Before sprinting out the exit, players can grab the Chastity "America's Next Top Hooker" collectible card resting on a table at the very back of the workshop. The encounter—which is subtly foreshadowed earlier in the story when Lucia gets jump-scared by a doll inside a cargo container—satirizes modern AI anxieties and tech-bro robotics startups with classic Rockstar absurdity.
author: ItsPrisey

title: Mystery Box / Alternate Dimension
description: Eat from a mysterious eye-marked box inside an open orange shipping container near Lake Tallaloko to get trapped in an alternate dimension.
content: On the southeastern shore of Lake Tallaloko in Lummox County, right on the border of Millport near an M7 gang operation camp, sits a quiet excavation and construction site. Tucked inside an open orange shipping container on the grounds is a lantern-lit workbench holding a small takeaway tin painted with an all-seeing eye. Approaching the container as either Jason or Lucia reveals a cryptic "???" interaction prompt that causes your character to eat a psychedelic mushroom from the box.

The moment the mushroom is consumed, the shipping container doors slam shut and reality dissolves into a surreal, "Backrooms"-inspired alternate dimension. You are thrust into an extended platforming and parkour puzzle through shifting corridors, a cavernous void of neon-lit floating shipping containers and suspended wooden logs, an underwater maze guided by bioluminescent jellyfish, and surreal walkways of fire and blooming flowers. At the climax of the obstacle course, you peer down into an open container to see a dancing doppelgänger of your character waving you down.

Leaping down toward your clone snaps you out of the hallucination and wakes you back up at the Lake Tallaloko excavation site hours later. Completing this mind-bending trip grants a permanent boost to your character's maximum stamina and unlocks the exclusive "Mind Maze" left-leg award tattoo, blending Rockstar's tradition of playable psychedelic trips with modern liminal-space horror aesthetics.
author: xGarbett

title: Pet Sematary-Style Cemetery
description: Follow the eerie, simultaneous cries of a missing dog and cat into the woods off SR-73 south of Grayson to uncover a candle-lit pet graveyard.
content: In the rural town of Grayson in southwestern Lummox County, observant players will notice missing-pet flyers plastered across walls—searching for a dog named Scramps, a house cat, and a rabbit—alongside an abandoned white building defaced with occult symbols and the warning "YOU ARE NOT ALONE OUT HERE." Heading south of Grayson off State Road 73 (SR-73) and venturing deep into the surrounding forest reveals the dark fate of those missing animals.

As you trek through the dense pines off SR-73, eerie, overlapping cries of a dog and a cat echo simultaneously through the woods. Following the unsettling animal noises leads to a secluded ritual clearing containing a small circle of stone pet graves, a food bowl, teddy bears, and a candle-lit stone altar. Pulling out your in-game smartphone and scanning the headstones with the WAiNK app officially logs the site as "Pet Cemetery" (Curiosity #19 of the 35 WAiNK Curiosities required for 100% completion).

The hidden graveyard and the spectral cries of the supposedly dead animals are a chilling nod to Stephen King's iconic 1983 horror novel Pet Sematary. Combined with the nearby occult ritual markings in Grayson, the Easter Egg implies that someone in Lummox County attempted to bring the town's lost pets back from beyond the grave.
author: GatorKeys_

title: Merman Photoshoot
description: Boat out to a secluded island beach in the Shoeless Keys to find a heavyset influencer in a sparkling turquoise mermaid tail livestreaming on a tripod.
content: On a small, secluded island beach in the Shoeless Keys—located just northwest of Key Lento across Gambit Bay in Mariana County—players can stumble upon an eccentric content creator known as Merman Ray. Take a boat or jet-ski from Jason's safehouse dock on Key Lento toward the isolated sandy island and look for a bright pink beach sunshade and a camera mounted on a tripod along the shoreline to trigger this random encounter.

Approaching the setup reveals a heavyset influencer lying in the surf wearing a seashell top and a sparkling turquoise mermaid tail while livestreaming to his subscribers. If you speak with him, he brags about feeling "mythical," flirts with your character, and plugs his social media channels before quietly breaking character to ask that if you run into his wife, you tell her he is out "bowling." He also complains that his tail is drying out and chafing in the sun, asking you to mist him down with a nearby water spray bottle. Helping him keep his tail wet for the camera earns his enthusiastic thanks, lets you snap selfies together, and rewards your character with a permanent Focus stat boost.

Alternatively, you can choose to sabotage his photoshoot by stepping directly in front of the camera lens or knocking over his tripod. Doing so causes Merman Ray to immediately drop his mystical persona and angrily confront you like a typical Leonida local for ruining his livestream. Nearby in Gambit Bay, explorers can also discover his custom rainbow-painted boat, the Lure Predator L20S ("Rainbow Ripple"), anchored off the island shore.
author: SicklyTheNinJa

title: Influencer and Python Encounter
description: Venture along the muddy banks of the Pelican River in Mariana County to find a massive Burmese python halfway through swallowing a solo content creator whole.
content: Deep within the southern marshlands of Mariana County along the muddy banks of the Pelican River and Watson Bay, players exploring off the beaten path can discover a grim cautionary tale about Leonida's invasive wildlife. Tucked into the dense brush near the water's edge lies a massive dead Burmese python that has ambushed and is halfway through swallowing an outdoor influencer whole, with only her legs still protruding from the snake's jaws.

Lying in the grass right beside the giant constrictor is the victim's dropped smartphone. Interacting with the phone plays her final recorded video clip: a cheerful vlog filmed moments before the attack where she talks about visiting the river with her dad to feed the ducks and record solo nature content. The dark sight gag satirizes clout-chasing social media culture colliding with the lethal reality of the Grassrivers ecosystem.

The encounter serves as both a memorable environmental Easter Egg and a nod to real-life Florida Everglades headlines regarding invasive Burmese pythons. While exploring the surrounding Pelican River and Pelican Valley wetlands, players can also log live Burmese pythons for their Leonida wildlife compendium or track down the legendary Skunk Ape nearby.
author: whooisaakash

title: Fatal Incursion Memorial
description: Head to the beachside park at the southwestern tip of Key Lento to find a candlelit clown shrine dedicated to the ill-fated band Fatal Incursion.
content: At the very southwestern tip of Key Lento in Mariana County, players can find a bizarre seaside shrine known as the Fatal Incursion Plaque. To reach it, follow Surfside Drive all the way southwest past the Key Lento Marina, the local barber shop, and the Barnacle Beauties salon until the road ends at a small beachside park overlooking the ocean. Situated right by the water's edge is a memorial monument adorned with candles and clown-themed tribute statues.

The plaque pays tribute to Fatal Incursion, an in-universe heavy metal and horrorcore duo that parodies the Insane Clown Posse and is idolized by the Fooliganz gang (led by Dax and associated with Wade Hebert in Grand Theft Auto V and GTA Online: Los Santos Drug Wars, which featured a mission titled "Fatal Incursion"). According to the lore inscription on the monument, the band members met an untimely demise following a tragic plane crash and a bizarre "boofing accident" off the Leonida Keys.

In addition to being a deep-cut Rockstar lore callback, the Fatal Incursion Memorial counts as one of Leonida's 23 scannable WAiNK Sculptures required for 100% completion and the "You WAiNKer!" trophy. Hold Up on the D-Pad near the monument to pull out your phone, open the WAiNK app, and scan the plaque. Keen explorers can also dive offshore from Key Lento to explore the sunken fuselage of the Fatal Incursion jet wreck, where Meteorite Fragment #1 rests on a passenger seat.
author: GTABase

title: Circles of Hell Encounter
description: Hang out with two metalhead Satanists in an open Port Gellhorn garage after midnight and ride their van to a forest ritual.
content: Starting in Chapter 2, players can trigger a wild, DOOM-inspired supernatural encounter in northern Port Gellhorn, Kelly County. Visit the residential streets climbing north from Gellhorn Avenue overlooking Draper Bay between 12:00 AM and 4:00 AM and look for a corner house with "Welcome to the Hellhole" spray-painted on the facade. When the event is active, the garage door will be open, glowing with red light and blasting heavy metal music.

Walk into the garage as either Jason or Lucia and speak with the two metalhead Satanists on the couch, Beelzebub and Dave. Choose positive dialogue prompts ("Having Fun?", "It's Good", and agreeing when asked if you are into Satanism) and share a drink with them until their friend Steve the Serpent pulls up outside in a custom-painted '79 Bravado Youga XL van. Climb into the back of the van to ride out to a ritual campsite in the woods outside Port Gellhorn, where cultists are chanting around a blazing bonfire. Approach the flames after taking their shroom offering and hold the "Stare into the Fire" prompt to pass out and awaken in Hell armed with a shotgun.

Inside the underworld arena, blast your way through waves of demonic minions and glowing green portals until you reach the throne of Satan ("The Pretender"). Because the boss is immune to damage while his health bar is black, you must shoot the exploding demons near his summoned black goats to strip his protection, turning his health bar red so you can unload your shotgun into him. Defeating Satan returns you to the forest campsite and rewards you with a permanent maximum health upgrade, the unbuyable Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun resting beside the wooden ritual throne, an exclusive Circles of Hell T-shirt, and demonic tattoo designs at Leonida tattoo parlors.
author: xGarbett

title: No Flushers Conspiracy
description: Scan a "#NOFLUSHERS" QR code poster inside a public restroom and reply "TRUTH" to meet conspiracy theorist Dr. Merle at Frank's Waffles in Vice City.
content: The "No Flushers" conspiracy is a hidden Strangers & Freaks side mission titled "The Final Flush" that begins inside public restrooms scattered across Leonida. The easiest place to start is the public bathroom block at the northern tip of Corsair Key (just northeast of Key Lento), or inside the restroom stalls at Nine1Nine and Dynamix Fitness in Vice City. Look on the wall for a handmade flyer reading "STOP! DON'T FLUSH / Scan to learn the truth #NOFLUSHERS" and use your in-game phone's WAiNK app to scan its large QR code.

Scanning the poster triggers an automated text message congratulating you on being in the top 1% of human thinkers. Reply with the prompt "TRUTH" to join the movement, and you will receive the secret passcode 00-00-02 along with instructions to meet their contact after dark at Frank's Waffles in the Tequesta district of Vice City. Inside the diner, approach an unhinged older conspiracy theorist named Dr. Merle muttering in a booth near the restrooms. After you give him the passcode, Merle explains his theory that tech moguls and government agents are harvesting citizens' DNA from public sewage to clone them—before swallowing a live GPS tracker and flushing it down the diner toilet.

Follow Dr. Merle outside into his research van and drive through the streets using his shouted compass bearings until the tracker signal leads you to the local sewage-treatment facility. Sneak past the night shift workers by pretending to be electricians, solve the upstairs walkway control panel puzzle by turning the indicator lights green and pulling the lever, and follow Merle down into the underground holding chamber. Pressing the red control button to flush Dr. Merle—and stepping into the chamber yourself—concludes the bizarre quest, waking you up back at your safehouse with a permanent, decay-proof maximum stamina upgrade.
author: mislead

title: Bikini Girl from Trailer 1
description: Head to the back deck of the yacht during the Chapter 1 mission "Day Release" to meet the famous Bikini Girl from Trailer 1 as Lucia.
content: For nearly three years following the release of Grand Theft Auto VI's debut trailer in December 2023, one of the community's biggest obsessions was the identity of the "Bikini Girl" posing on a rooftop at the 0:38 mark. Fans spent countless hours conducting frame-by-frame mole comparisons and facial analyses, debating whether the woman in the white-and-gold bikini and pink-tinted aviator sunglasses was actually protagonist Lucia Caminos in a different hairstyle and outfit.

Rockstar Games officially put the theory to rest early in Chapter 1 during "Day Release," the first major story mission where you play as Lucia alongside Jason. While attending the yacht party and searching the vessel for Mattia, you can take a detour toward the stern (back deck) of the yacht before completing the main objective. Standing near the railing with a blue smartphone is the exact same woman from Trailer 1, wearing her signature patterned white bikini and tinted aviators, proving once and for all that she and Lucia are two completely separate people.

If you walk up and interact with her while playing as Lucia, Rockstar included a fourth-wall-breaking dialogue exchange that pokes fun at the years of internet speculation. Lucia remarks, "You look really familiar, are you a celebrity?" to which the Bikini Girl casually replies that she is a famous model, prompting Lucia to conclude that must be where she recognizes her from.
author: viztur

title: Cool Dog and Dog Island
description: Strand yourself in the open waters of Gambit Bay and a golden retriever in goggles will pull up on a jet-ski to rescue you.
content: If you ever find yourself stranded far out at sea in the Leonida Keys, one of Grand Theft Auto VI's most charming random encounters will come to your rescue. To trigger the event, pilot a boat out from Key Lento into the open waters of Gambit Bay, jump overboard, and swim away from your vessel until you are completely isolated from land and other boat traffic. After treading water for a minute or two, you will hear frantic barking in the distance before a golden retriever wearing doggles and a life vest pulls up beside you at the handlebars of a jet-ski.

By entering Focus Mode, praising the canine—affectionately named "Cool Dog"—and climbing onto the back seat, you can let the four-legged captain chauffeur you across the waves. Rather than dropping you off at the nearest mainland pier, staying on the jet-ski allows Cool Dog to ferry you to an uncharted offshore sandbar dubbed "Dog Island." There, a pack of five other friendly dogs greets you on the beach, where you can pet them and play fetch with a ball.

After spending enough time hanging out and playing fetch with the pack on the island, Cool Dog will lead you over to a buried stash in the sand containing a wallet with over $1,200 in cash and valuables. The entire encounter is a heartfelt tribute to Loosy, a real-life golden retriever from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, who became a local legend and viral sensation for riding around on a personal watercraft in goggles and a life jacket with her owner.
author: ChizPlays

title: Wade's Podcast Appearance
description: Tune into the "Final Act" true-crime podcast to hear Wade Hebert interviewed from prison after taking the fall for Floyd and Debra's murders.
content: Grand Theft Auto VI bridges the thirteen-year gap since Grand Theft Auto V through its on-demand car radio podcasts, most notably a true-crime conspiracy show titled "Final Act" (featured under the Vice City True Stories banner). Hosted by investigative journalists Reagan Carter and J.B. Bradshaw, the multi-episode series digs into the chaotic aftermath of the 2013 Los Santos crime wave and reveals the grim fate of Trevor Philips' loyal juggalo sidekick, Wade Hebert.

As new episodes unlock across the campaign, listeners learn that Wade was arrested in 2014, pinned with the grisly murders of his cousin Floyd Hebert and Floyd's fiancée Debra in their Vespucci Beach condo, and sentenced to 50 years in a maximum-security penitentiary. During a prison interview on the podcast, Matthew Maher reprises his role as Wade, who remains fiercely protective of his old crew even behind bars. When shown a photograph of Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, and Trevor, Wade refuses to name his "BFF," describes Michael as a clever family man, and calls Franklin a "street rascal."

The podcast hosts openly doubt that the gullible Wade could ever be a criminal mastermind, zeroing in on his accidental slip-up asking what happened with "robbing all them banks" before hastily claiming the trio are just respected businessmen. Across its run, "Final Act" weaves a hilarious meta-narrative around the events of GTA V, complete with additional returning voice cameos from retired FIB agent Dave Norton and Vinewood movie producer Solomon Richards.
author: DiscussingFilm

title: Mount Chiliad Mystery Conversation
description: Linger outside the bar before meeting Brian Heder in Chapter 1 to overhear two locals gossiping about the "Mount Chiliad situation in San Andreas."
content: Thirteen years after the cryptic cable car mural atop Mount Chiliad sent Grand Theft Auto V players on one of gaming's longest-running treasure hunts, Rockstar Games slipped a direct callback to the phenomenon into an early Chapter 1 mission in Grand Theft Auto VI. The Easter Egg takes place when Donald "Donnie" Carter calls Jason Duval to meet up with him and Keys drug trafficker Brian Heder in the Leonida Keys.

Upon arriving at the meeting spot, Donnie instructs Jason to head over to the bar next door where Brian is waiting. If you slow down and linger near the outdoor seating area as you approach the bar's entrance, you can overhear two local patrons seated at a table gossiping about the "crazy Mount Chiliad situation in San Andreas." Specifically, the pair talk about rumors of a hidden government bunker buried deep beneath the Blaine County mountain packed with jetpacks and alien eggs.

Because this dialogue is drawn from the ambient world chatter pool, it can be easily missed if you sprint straight inside to trigger Brian's cutscene. For longtime Rockstar mystery hunters, the exchange serves as a clever wink to the 2013 Chiliad mural symbols—the UFO, the cracked egg, and the stick-figure jetpack—while canonizing the underground Mount Chiliad launch facility and Thruster jetpack introduced in GTA Online's The Doomsday Heist alongside wider Chiliad lore like the "Chiliad '62" alien handshake photo found in President Russo's bunker.
author: ASexyBiscuit

title: Hidden Alien Storyline
description: Get abducted by a UFO in Kelly County, solve a playable alien dream puzzle and rescue a captive alien for permanent stat boosts.
content: To begin the hidden alien storyline in Leonida, first complete Chapter 1 and drive alone as either Jason or Lucia along the dirt roads northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2:00 AM. Follow a stranded car's flashing headlights toward an eerie blue glow in the woods, where a UFO is abducting a local woman. After the saucer drops her and you help retrieve her car, the UFO returns to abduct your character—unlocking "The Truth Is Out There" trophy—before leaving you in a field at dawn.

Once back in free roam, sleep repeatedly at a safehouse as the abducted character until a playable dream sequence places you back aboard the alien spacecraft. Sneak past the alien eggs, interact with the Earth orb, and count the illuminated tally lines above the keypad door from left to right to learn your save file's unique four-digit code (such as 2134 or 2314). Inside the control room, align the four-button blue light puzzle, grab the jug of milk from the left chamber, and insert it into the machine on the right to end the dream and reveal the location of a secret terrestrial facility.

Travel to the fenced government research compound at South Point Airfield (south of Hamlet) and enter the main building via the roof hatch or front double doors. Take the downstairs keypad-locked elevator into the underground bunker using the four-digit code from your dream, then repeat the four-button control panel sequence and the milk machine puzzle. Carrying the freed alien back up to the surface summons a UFO that beams the creature to safety, wipes out the pursuing soldiers, and rewards your character with a permanent boost to maximum Health, Stamina, and Focus.
author: RileyRalmuto

title: Painted Eggs in a Bird's Nest
description: Climb for seven minutes to the top of the tallest radio tower in South Vice-Dale County to find a bird's nest full of literal painted Easter eggs.
content: Head to the massive red-and-white communications tower located in the Bluegrass area of South Vice-Dale County, just north of Hamlet. Hop the perimeter fence at the base and begin climbing the tower's exterior ladder all the way to the highest platform, which roughly takes around six to seven minutes of real time to complete.

When you reach the summit platform, look to the right to find a bird's nest filled with brightly painted pastel Easter eggs, accompanied by a free parachute for the trip back down. Approaching the nest displays an interaction prompt literally labeled "EASTER EGG," allowing Jason or Lucia to pick up one of the colorful eggs like a throwable weapon.

Tossing the painted egg over the ledge triggers a secret cinematic cutscene that tracks the egg as it spirals hundreds of feet down like a football. It ultimately splats straight onto the windshield of an obnoxious driver dressed in classic 1980s Vice City attire while he shouts into his mobile phone below, serving as a hilarious callback to the literal chocolate Easter egg hidden in 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City.
author: xGarbett

title: Creepy Candle-Lit Room
description: Open the side doors along the hotel hallway as a drunk Lucia during the "Day Release" mission to stumble upon a pitch-dark room ringed with candles.
content: This missable horror encounter takes place during the Chapter 1 story mission "Day Release" in Vice City's Ocean Beach district. After the nightclub sequence moves to the hotel, play until an intoxicated Lucia steps out of the hotel bathroom into a long corridor to look for Jason and the rest of the group.

Before walking to the objective marker at the end of the hall, approach the row of brown side doors lining either side of the corridor and interact with them. While most doors open onto comedic party antics that reshuffle as you close and reopen them, one door (frequently triggered at Room 305 or the final unlockable side door) reveals a pitch-black room lit only by a circle of burning candles on the floor.

Inside the candle-lit room, a bloodied, tattooed man stands completely motionless facing the corner wall with his back to the doorway. Unlike the other hallway gags, Lucia offers no commentary—she simply stares in silence before backing out and shutting the door, leaving the eerie Blair Witch Project-style tableau completely unexplained.
author: Pirat_Nation

title: Area 69 Incident
description: Inspect the rear bumpers of countryside traffic and walls around the Thrillbilly Mud Club to spot a sticker reading "Introvert but willing to talk about the 1992 Area 69 incident."
content: While exploring the backroads of Leonida, particularly around Port Gellhorn, Mount Kalaga National Park, and the countryside of Kelly County, players can spot conspiracy-themed bumper stickers plastered on the rear bumpers of local traffic vehicles. Several of these stickers are also stuck to walls, trailers, and props around the Thrillbilly Mud Club off-road park in Frogswater.

The bumper sticker bears the logo of the Lil' Probe'Inn—the iconic flying-saucer-shaped roadside tavern from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas—and reads: "Introvert but willing to talk about the 1992 Area 69 incident."

The text is a direct lore nod to the 1992 setting of GTA: San Andreas and its memorable mission "Black Project," in which Carl "CJ" Johnson infiltrates the top-secret Area 69 military research base in Bone County under cover of night to steal a $60,000,000 experimental jetpack for eccentric conspiracy theorist The Truth.
author: RCD16_

title: Assman Licence Plate (Seinfeld)
description: Steal the Imponte Phoenix from the Hamlet police impound and check its rear bumper to find a Leonida vanity plate reading "ASS MAN."
content: Early in Chapter 1, during the mission "Unwanted Attention," Jason is sent to sneak into the Hamlet police impound yard in the Leonida Keys to recover a bright red Imponte Phoenix muscle car decorated with flame decals. Looking closely at the rear bumper reveals a custom Leonida flamingo license plate that reads "ASSMAN" (spaced as "ASS MAN").

The plate remains clearly visible as you drive the Phoenix out of the impound lot and take it to be resprayed to shake off police attention, and it can also occasionally be spotted on a classic convertible parked outside a medical clinic strip mall in Downtown Vice City.

The vanity plate is a direct homage to the classic Seinfeld Season 6 episode "The Fusilli Jerry," in which Cosmo Kramer visits the DMV and is accidentally issued the "ASSMAN" license plates meant for a proctologist—a tribute that even prompted Seinfeld actor Michael Richards to share a photo of himself with the GTA 6 plate on social media.
author: DogManX31

title: Tenebrae Lux Video Game
description: Play the black-and-white first-person puzzle game Tenebrae Lux on the JoyStation console in Jason's safehouse.
content: During the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui', Cal Hampton hooks up a JoyStation console in the living room of Jason's Key Lento safehouse, unlocking a fully playable game-within-a-game titled Tenebrae Lux. First teased on a bedroom poster in Rockstar's Extended Look trailer, its Latin title ('Darkness Light') led fans to link it to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.

Created in-universe by fictional pretentious indie auteur Johannes Zuch (a direct parody of The Witness creator Jonathan Blow), Tenebrae Lux places you on a monochromatic island with a lighthouse inspired by Robert Eggers' The Lighthouse. Players solve four stages of cerebral puzzles: 3D grid-sliding boards on the beach, a looping bunker phone code derived from calendar date anomalies, a symbol-matching bridge crossing, and a final set of lighthouse doors.

If you repeatedly fail the final lighthouse door puzzle, the pretentious narrator loses his patience, breaks the fourth wall to tell you to 'just look the answer up on your iFruit', and eventually yells out that the solution is 'urinal etiquette'.
author: realradec

title: Red Dead Redemption / Liberty City Books
description: Flip through readable books at Jacob's Tavern in Millport, Brian's Marina, and Jason's safehouse to find direct lore connections to Red Dead Redemption and Liberty City.
content: Grand Theft Auto VI features 27 readable books, magazines, and comics scattered across Leonida, several of which explicitly bridge the universes of Red Dead Redemption and Grand Theft Auto. Inside Jacob's Tavern in Millport (Lummox County) and at Brian Heder's marina office in Key Lento, players can pick up and read Elijah G. Rubens' pulp Western novel, The Cowboy's Prayer Is to Die Young.

The novel follows bounty hunter Rust McCreary across iconic Red Dead locations including New Austin, Armadillo, Blackwater, Chuparosa, and Ambarino. In one chapter shared by @GameRoll_, McCreary visits a snowbound cabin at Cairn Lake and discovers outlaw Flaco Hernández dead with a bullet hole in his forehead—the exact aftermath of Arthur Morgan's duel with Hernández in Red Dead Redemption 2.

Meanwhile, on a small table by the back door of Jason's house in Chapter 1 sits another readable book titled Lethal by Design: A Liberty City Memoir, written by a former Liberty City mobster recounting organized crime events from 2008, the year Grand Theft Auto IV takes place.
author: GameRoll_

title: Brian O'Conner's Eclipse (Fast & Furious)
description: Break into a locked villa garage on Vespucci Island to steal a green Maibatsu Penumbra FF with a 'HAD YOU' plate from The Fast and the Furious.
content: Near the center of Vespucci Island (part of the Rialto Islands between mainland Vice City and Vice Beach), players can find a modern white residential villa across from a house under construction. Locked inside its attached garage sits a custom 1997 Maibatsu Penumbra FF finished in bright green with racing decals, a carbon hood, and a tall rear wing.

The car is a 1:1 tribute to the iconic 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse driven by Paul Walker's character, Brian O'Conner, in the opening street race of 2001's The Fast and the Furious. Its rear Leonida license plate reads 'HAD YOU', referencing Brian's famous line to Dominic Toretto ('Dude, I almost had you!'), while popping open the trunk unleashes a lunging snake in a playful nod to Woody's 'There's a snake in my boot!' from Toy Story.

To claim the car, hop the villa's privacy gate, break into the garage side door, immediately disarm the wall alarm panel, and flip the garage door switch before hotwiring the ignition. Once you reach Chapter 2, you can register the Penumbra FF at Moses' shop or any Pay 'n' Spray to keep it permanently.
author: brewski77

title: Collateral / Tom Cruise-Style Encounter
description: A silver-haired hitman in a dark suit and sunglasses hijacks your car at gunpoint and forces you to chauffeur him to Harborside Park in Vice Beach, recreating Tom Cruise's Vincent from Collateral.
content: While driving through Vice City and Vice Beach, players can trigger a 'Forced Driver' random encounter that pays direct homage to Michael Mann's 2004 neo-noir thriller Collateral, starring Tom Cruise and Jamie Foxx. When you slow down or idle near the curb, a calm, gray-haired man wearing a tailored suit and dark sunglasses climbs into your car and holds you at gunpoint.

Channeling Tom Cruise's contract killer Vincent, the passenger tells Jason he needs to 'borrow' him, barks 'You drive when I say drive, you stop when I say stop,' forces him to run a red light so traffic cameras log his face, and orders him to ignore an incoming phone call from Lucia during the ride to Harborside Park in Vice Beach.

Upon arriving at Harborside Park, the hitman steps out of the vehicle, delivers Vincent's famous alleyway line—'Yo, homie'—and executes two targets on the spot. Once he walks away (or if you gun him down), you can raid the nearby stash house for cash and a duffel bag of contraband at the cost of a two-star wanted level.
author: DiscussingFilm

title: Dexter Morgan's Apartment
description: Visit the waterfront Trinity Apartments on Washington Island in Vice Beach to find a recreation of Dexter Morgan's Miami condo.
content: On the northern waterfront of Washington Island in Vice Beach—tucked right between the Pay 'n' Spray and the Top Fun Drones shop—stands a pale-blue, two-story courtyard condo complex named Trinity Apartments. The building is a faithful 1:1 recreation of the real-life Bay Harbor Club in Miami Beach that served as Dexter Morgan's home in Showtime's hit series Dexter, while its in-game name nods to Season 4 villain Arthur Mitchell, the Trinity Killer.

Climbing the southern spiral staircase and walking down the second-floor exterior balcony leads to Dexter's corner unit overlooking the water. Although the blue front door is locked, players can spot the exact window air-conditioning unit where Dexter hid his wooden box of trophies, and climbing the rear ladder to the roof reveals his signature kill kit laid out: M99 syringes, a butcher knife, rope, duct tape, gloves, and a duffel bag.

Down at the private dock directly behind Trinity Apartments sits a white fishing boat with twin outboard motors (a Lure Predator L35P) modeled after Dexter's vessel, the Slice of Life, which you can steal and pilot out into the Atlantic.
author: Dexerto

title: Dexter Morgan's Kill Room
description: Lift the garage door of a coastal house on Surfside Drive in South Key Lento to discover Dexter's kill room.
content: While Dexter Morgan's condo on Washington Island keeps its front door locked, Rockstar hid a second, enterable Dexter homage down in Leonida Keys. Along Surfside Drive in South Key Lento—not far from Jason's starting safehouse—players can find an unassuming coastal house with an attached white garage door and a beach ball resting in the yard.

Approaching the garage allows Jason or Lucia to lift the door and step inside a chilling recreation of a classic Bay Harbor Butcher kill room. Heavy translucent plastic sheeting is taped from floor to ceiling around a central metal surgical table.

Laid out across the counters and table are Dexter's trademark tools: a bottle of M99 animal tranquilizer and syringes, bone saws, cleavers, scalpel blades, and tied-off black garbage bags stained with blood. Eagle-eyed fans also spotted a chainsaw on the right counter (referencing the murder of Dexter's mother, Laura Moser) and a claw hammer (a nod to the Trinity Killer).
author: DETONATEDcom

title: Fabien LaRouche Magazine Feature
description: Read Issue 79 of Body Copy magazine on Jason's back deck in Key Lento to learn that GTA V yoga instructor Fabien LaRouche now teaches tantric yoga to wealthy seniors in Waning Sands.
content: Resting on a table beside the outdoor workout equipment on the back deck of Jason's house in Key Lento during Chapter 1 is a readable collectible fitness magazine titled Body Copy: America's Fittest Bodybuilding Magazine (Issue 79). Be sure to flip through it before the end of Chapter 1, as the safehouse copy becomes missable later in the story.

Turning to the feature article titled 'Twilight Tantra' reveals the post-2013 fate of Fabien LaRouche, Amanda De Santa's pretentious French yoga instructor from Grand Theft Auto V ('Did Somebody Say Yoga?'). According to the interview, Fabien fled the 'karmic decay of Los Santos' in the early 2010s to tour ashrams, five-star resorts, and plastic-surgery retreats.

Now relocated to the state of Leonida, Fabien is wrapping up a lucrative six-month residency teaching senior citizens at the Dwindle Wood Retirement Community in Waning Sands (Leonard County)—with the article heavily implying he is preying on wealthy retirees' bank accounts.
author: Wilh_Flashito

title: Giant Enemy Crab Meme
description: Log into the terminal at the abandoned crab research site north of Key Lento with the password 'CLEAVES' and a giant mutant crab drops from the rafters.
content: In the Pelican Valley marshes of Gullet Marsh just north of Key Lento sits an abandoned marine research compound complete with broken aquariums, dead crabs, and a locked pier boathouse. Flip the high-voltage breaker box on the exterior wall of the main building to restore power, then head inside and log into the research terminal using the password CLEAVES (scratched into the bedroom floorboards).

After you read the scientist's logs about mutated 'Leonida Blue' specimens and exit the computer screen, a monstrous glowing-eyed crab drops from the ceiling rafters and pins your character to the floor in a surprise jump-scare cutscene. Mashing the prompt kicks the creature off before it scuttles away into the swamp, paying homage to Sony's famous E3 2006 'Giant Enemy Crab' presentation meme.

Solving the lab's 'Double Success' clue—doubling successful Specimen #0036 from a nearby clipboard—yields safe code 0072 for over $1,000 in cash and the dock keypad code 0212, which unlocks the boathouse outside containing $10,000, a Seashark jet-ski, and the unique golden Crabshack VF5 SMG.
author: ChumBucketDrama

title: Michael De Santa's Boat
description: Climb onto the blue Marquis sailboat parked in Jason's front yard in Key Lento and zoom in on its dashboard GPS: it still shows the map of Los Santos, linking it to Michael's stolen yacht from GTA V.
content: Right from the opening scene of Chapter 1 in Key Lento, a white-and-blue Marquis sailboat sits propped up on blocks in the front yard outside Jason Duval's safehouse. The vessel is the exact same model and colorway as Michael De Santa's beloved yacht in Grand Theft Auto V, which was stolen on the freeway during the mission 'Father/Son' after Jimmy tried to sell it.

If you climb onto the stern of the boat, stand behind the helm, and zoom in on the dashboard's GPS screen using binoculars, the navigation radar does not display the waters of Leonida. Instead, it still displays the southern coastline and Port of Los Santos from GTA V.

The detail ignited massive community speculation—and even drew a joke on X from Michael De Santa actor Ned Luke ('I'm coming Jason… For my boat')—suggesting that the stolen yacht eventually made its way across the country into the hands of Brian Heder and Jason in the Leonida Keys.
author: Pilasto1

title: Rad Dads Redemption Tour Flyer
description: Check the community noticeboard outside Three Sheets Liquor in Key Lento to spot a skull-adorned concert poster for the 'Rad Dads Redemption Tour', a pun on Red Dead Redemption.
content: While visiting Three Sheets Liquor in Key Lento during Chapter 1 (where Jason picks up rum for Shirley and can also discover a talking parrot guarding hidden cash out back), inspect the community bulletin board mounted on the exterior wall beside the entrance.

Pinned among local classifieds for boat rentals and bandmates is a weathered concert flyer featuring a skull illustration that advertises free entry for a local dad-rock band's 'Rad Dads Live Music Redemption Tour'.

Both the title pun and the Western-inspired skull typography are a playful nod from Rockstar's environment artists to Red Dead Redemption, joining several other Red Dead callbacks scattered around Key Lento.
author: SnowEmbrace

title: Red Hulk Parody
description: Help strawberry farmer Kyle McKittrick spray experimental chemicals on his Kelly County crops and he eventually mutates into a rampaging giant.
content: During Chapter 2 of Grand Theft Auto VI, players can pick up a three-part Strangers & Freaks storyline centered around Kyle McKittrick, a strawberry farmer and crop-duster pilot in Kelly County. To begin the questline, visit the Starlet Motel east of Port Gellhorn and interact with the "Pilot Wanted" flyer posted outside the reception office, which marks McKittrick Farm in Frogswater on your map. In the first two missions—"Check Out McKittrick Farm" and "Collect Chemicals for Kyle"—Jason or Lucia helps Kyle dust his fields and acquire an unapproved chemical shipment from the Final Chapter biker gang to fuel his oversized strawberry experiments.

Several in-game weeks later (typically triggering in Chapter 3), Kyle sends a garbled text message prompting the final encounter, "Buddy?". Returning to McKittrick Farm reveals the property surrounded by local law enforcement and Mutandis agents. Having consumed his own chemically mutated strawberries, Kyle bursts out of his barn transformed into a giant, crimson-skinned brute. Players can either equip a hazmat suit and side with the authorities to take him down for a $5,000 reward, or stand back and let him rampage through the blockade.

If you refrain from attacking Kyle, he will smash patrol cars and hurl armed soldiers into an airborne police helicopter to bring it crashing down—a direct visual parody of Marvel's Red Hulk and his helicopter-destroying sequence in Captain America: Brave New World. Once Kyle exhausts himself and sits down, you can approach him peacefully and give the giant mutant a hug before he leaps high into the air and vanishes from the farm, leaving his crop-duster plane unlocked at his airstrip.
author: CultureCrave

title: Race and Chase 7 Joke
description: Scroll through the in-game Snapmatic app on Jason or Lucia's phone to spot Rockstar's parody of the real-world "before GTA 6" meme.
content: While browsing the in-game Snapmatic social media app on Jason or Lucia's smartphone, players can stumble across a viral post from the handle @thebookofmemers that brings one of gaming's longest-running internet jokes full circle. The post features mock box art for a fictional children's game titled Barnyard Blue: Hot Fursuit, paired with the caption "we really got barnyard blue games before RAC7" and overlay text reading, "Barnyard Blue video game before Race and Chase 7 is crazy."

To see the Easter Egg yourself, open your character's phone at any point during free roam and scroll through the public Snapmatic feed. Alongside the Barnyard Blue post, additional social media chatter on the app jokes about "Race and Chase 7" suffering another year-long delay, mirroring the decade of real-world anticipation that preceded the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI.

The joke operates on two levels of Rockstar history. Before the original Grand Theft Auto launched in 1997, its working title at DMA Design (now Rockstar North) was Race'n'Chase, a name later repurposed as an in-universe arcade game franchise in GTA Online. By substituting "Race and Chase 7" (RAC7) into the famous "We got [X] before GTA 6" meme format, Rockstar simultaneously immortalizes the real-world community meme and preemptively pokes fun at the wait for Grand Theft Auto VII.
author: DiscussingFilm

title: Terminator 2 Rose-Box Shotgun Entrance
description: At the end of Chapter 1 in the mission "Discharge Time," an enemy gunman ambushes Jason and Lucia. The entrance recreates Arnold Schwarzenegger's T-800 mall scene from Terminator 2.
content: During "Discharge Time," the climactic final story mission of Chapter 1, Lucia infiltrates a Leonida medical facility to break an injured Jason out of custody. As the duo fights their way toward the exit and an ambush ensues in the hospital corridor, the very first gunman to confront them walks calmly down the hallway carrying a long gold box of roses.

Rather than engaging like a standard cover shooter NPC, the attacker pauses, reaches into the flower box, and pulls out a concealed shotgun before opening fire on Jason and Lucia. Because the sequence happens in real time at the start of the hallway firefight, quick-thinking players can gun the assassin down mid-animation as the roses scatter across the floor.

The entrance, prop design, and deliberate body language are a frame-for-frame homage to James Cameron's 1991 sci-fi action classic Terminator 2: Judgment Day. In the film's famous Galleria mall corridor scene, Arnold Schwarzenegger's T-800 conceals a lever-action shotgun inside an identical long gold box of red roses before stepping on the scattered flowers to intercept the T-1000.
author: DiscussingFilm

title: San Andreas House Reference
description: Track down the bungalow in Belville, Leonard County to uncover a self-aware NPC.
content: In the suburban town of Belville in Leonard County, players can track down a single-story bungalow with a double garage, two front-yard palm trees, and a Cellerica "dream house" billboard right next door. First pinpointed by community mapper Jared from the GTA VI Mapping Discord server, the house's exterior and foliage are an exact match for a mysterious framed UFO photograph hung on the wall of the Lil' Probe'Inn bar in 2021's Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas remaster—confirming a five-year fan theory that Rockstar hid our very first screenshot of GTA 6 inside the remaster.

While the front door of the Belville residence is locked, players can break into the attached garage to uncover a dark, fourth wall breaking secret. The interior serves as the bunker of an absent, self-aware NPC conspiracy theorist who has realized that the state of Leonida is actually a video game simulation. A massive corkboard hangs on the wall with "IT'S A SIMULATION" scrawled in red letters, surrounded by repeated drawings of the number 6 and graphs tracking an unnatural spike in violent crime, hinting at the game's release.

Closer inspection of the pinned notes reveals the resident's terror over video game logic: he documents seeing "IDENTICAL PEOPLE" (repeating NPC models) on the streets, cars vanishing into thin air, neighbors who never enter their homes because nothing exists behind locked doors, and failed attempts to buy a plane ticket to Los Santos or drive past the state borders. Sticky notes even single out the game's protagonists, asking "Who is J" and "Who is L" before concluding that "J + L are the only free ones," while a collectible issue of the conspiracy magazine Foiled rests on the bed nearby.
author: xGarbett

title: Vercetti Estate Reference
description: Cross the bridge onto Starfish Island in Vice City to explore the modernized grounds of the Vercetti Estate.
content: Longtime franchise fans exploring Vice City can cross the bridge onto Starfish Island—the gated enclave of waterfront mansions situated between mainland Vice City and Ocean Beach—to visit a modernized incarnation of the iconic Vercetti Estate. Located on the same prime waterfront plot where Tommy Vercetti seized Ricardo Diaz's mansion in 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, the grand cream-colored residence retains its unmistakable white façade columns, sweeping front steps, and central courtyard fountain.

Players can freely drive past the Starfish Island guardhouse and walk the estate grounds in free roam without triggering a wanted level. Although the mansion's front doors are locked—leaving its modeled rooms only visible through the windows—a gaudy leopard-print Big Cat Furia supercar frequently spawns right in the circular driveway, and a jet-ski sits waiting by the rear dock overlooking the Vice City skyline. Rockstar also explicitly canonized the property's name in the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition via the Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers, whose description notes their palm-tree-etched grips were "sourced from the Vercetti Estate."
author: MemeioYT

title: Tommy Vercetti's Outfit & 2002 Vice City Portal
description: Activate the Badger R&D Radio Tower and 12 LPL electrical substations spelling "LIFE IS PASSING ME BY" to enter a 2002 Malibu Club portal and unlock Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt.
content: Beyond visiting the Starfish Island mansion itself, players can unlock Tommy Vercetti's signature blue Hawaiian shirt ("The Street" outfit) through an elaborate Vice City nostalgia puzzle discovered by MemeioYT. Begin at the Badger R&D Radio Tower in Key Lento: climb the hill to the electrical box, pull the power lever to ON, and press the red button on the adjacent equipment board so the television flashes the classic 2002 Malibu Club palm logo alongside the clue "LPL SUBSTATION?" and a sequence of directional symbols.

Next, visit 12 Leonida Power & Light (LPL) electrical substations across Leonida in exact order so their graffiti letters spell out the classic 2002 GTA: Vice City cheat code "LIFEISPASSINGMEBY" (inputs: D, D, ., A, ., A, A, A, ., W, D, W): (1) 'L' in southern Downtown Vice City across the river [Press D]; (2) 'iF' west of Balsero in Vice City [Press D]; (3) 'Ei' in northeast Key Lento [Press .]; (4) 'S' behind the hospital in northern Vice Beach [Press A]; (5) 'P' in northern Vice City west of Bayside [Pull .]; (6) 'A' in northern Port Gellhorn [Pull A]; (7) 'Ss' southeast of Hamlet [Press A]; (8) 'iN' on Gloriana Key south of Catalan Bay [Press A]; (9) 'G' on the western outskirts of Hamlet [Pull .]; (10) 'Me' outside the racetrack southeast of Port Gellhorn [Pull W]; (11) 'B' in southern Hamlet [Pull D]; and (12) 'Y' at Breakwater Quarry southwest of Vice City International Airport [Pull W].

Completing all 12 substations triggers an automated text message reading "U-235 REACTOR2 19-06." Travel as Jason to Reactor 2 at the LPL Turtle Head Power Station east of Hamlet between 19:00 and 06:00 and step into the glowing purple portal inside the cooling tower. You are transported into a low-poly PS2-graphics rendition of the 1986 Malibu Club where Kent Paul hands you a drink before you wake up outside wearing Tommy Vercetti's blue Hawaiian shirt, with the custom Western Malibu Zombie Bobber motorcycle parked nearby.
author: MemeioYT
pos: Step 0: Badger R&D Radio Tower (Key Lento) — Flip power lever ON & press TV button
Substation 1 ('L' — Southern Downtown Vice City) — Press D button
Substation 2 ('iF' — West of Balsero, Vice City) — Press D button
Substation 3 ('Ei' — Northeast Key Lento) — Press . (Dot) button
Substation 4 ('S' — North Vice Beach Hospital) — Press A button
Substation 5 ('P' — North Vice City / West of Bayside) — Pull . (Dot) lever
Substation 6 ('A' — North Port Gellhorn) — Pull A lever
Substation 7 ('Ss' — Southeast Hamlet) — Press A button
Substation 8 ('iN' — Gloriana Key, South of Catalan Bay) — Press A button
Substation 9 ('G' — West Hamlet) — Pull . (Dot) lever
Substation 10 ('Me' — Racetrack Southeast of Port Gellhorn) — Pull W lever
Substation 11 ('B' — South Hamlet) — Pull D lever
Substation 12 ('Y' — Breakwater Quarry, SW of Airport) — Pull W lever
Finale: LPL Turtle Head Power Station (Reactor 2, 19:00–06:00) — Enter 2002 Malibu Club Portal

title: SpongeBob's Pineapple Bus Stop
description: Drive along Cicada Avenue near Bluegrass to find a giant yellow pineapple-shaped roadside bus stop inspired by SpongeBob SquarePants' house in Bikini Bottom.
content: While driving along Cicada Avenue near the rural community of Bluegrass in South Vice-Dale County, players can spot an unmistakable cartoon landmark sitting right beside a standard Leonida transit bus stop sign: a roadside shelter built in the shape of a giant yellow pineapple.

Topped with a crown of bright green leaves and fitted with circular metal porthole windows and an arched doorway frame, the structure is a direct tribute to SpongeBob SquarePants' iconic pineapple house at 124 Conch Street in Bikini Bottom.

Jason and Lucia can walk right through the open front doorway and take a seat on the wooden bus bench inside the pineapple while waiting for local transit, making it one of Leonida's most popular roadside photo spots.
author: GTAlphaintel

title: A55 GRL Peekhole Laptop & Vanessa's Growler
description: Crack the password on Peekhole creator Vanessa's bedroom laptop in Bayside Apartments to uncover an AI-prompt DM blunder and keypad code 92665 for a free garage and pink 'A55 GRL' Pfister Growler.
content: Once you move into Apartment 201 of the Bayside Apartments safehouse in Chapter 3 (formerly rented by adult creator Vanessa, known online as 'ViceCakes' on Rockstar's OnlyFans parody, Peekhole), you can find her password-locked laptop sitting beside a ring light in the bedroom. Because you lose access to Bayside Apartments at the end of Chapter 3, this puzzle is missable and must be completed before starting The Cartel Heist.

To unlock the password prompt options on the laptop, inspect three clues around the apartment: (1) the framed dog memorial photo on the hallway side table ('Muffins'); (2) the notepad drawing of a dog wearing a crown on the bedroom vanity ('Queen'); and (3) the back of that same notepad ('Class of '15 reunion' -> '15'). Logging in with Muffins -> Queen -> 15 lets you snoop through Vanessa's Peekhole DMs—including a message where she accidentally pasted a raw AI prompt ('[Write a flirty reply to a sub on Peekhole...]')—and open the WhatUp app to read a text from 'Unknown' revealing keypad code 92665 for a lock-up next to Auntie's Place in La Perle.

Head northwest to Del Rio Boulevard in southern La Perle (across the street from Twa Ponya Tattoo and right behind Aline's Thrift Store) and look for a concrete garage door decorated with a painted pink bow above the keypad. Entering 92665 permanently unlocks the 1-car Del Rio Boulevard Garage along with Vanessa's Growler—a baby-pink Pfister Growler sports car sporting a custom Leonida vanity license plate that reads 'A55 GRL'.
author: SicklyTheNinJa
pos: Step 1: Bayside Apartments (Unit 201) — Inspect 3 dog clues & unlock Vanessa's laptop (Muffins -> Queen -> 15)
Step 2: Del Rio Boulevard Garage (La Perle) — Enter code 92665 to unlock garage & Vanessa's 'A55 GRL' Pfister Growler

title: Snapmatic 1010 X Grotti Cheetah & Garage
description: Open the comments on @1010's Snapmatic post and photograph five optical-illusion street art murals across Vice City to unlock the Southside Storage garage and a custom '95 Grotti Cheetah.
content: Starting in Chapter 3, open the Snapmatic app on your in-game phone, scroll to the post by real-world street artist @1010 titled 'New 1010 X Grotti Collab', and open its comments section to kick off a hidden five-part photo hunt across Vice City and Ocean Beach. At each location, stand directly on the circular white '1010' floor mark and snap a photo using the standard Camera app (not the WAiNK scanner) so the layered paint aligns into a 3D optical-illusion portal.

The five 1010 Murals can be photographed in the following order: (1) 'Loophole Architecture' — stand on the roof of the Parlor Apartments on Northbrook Drive in Rockridge and aim down at the circular rainbow roof across the street; (2) 'You Signed the Terms & Conditions' — stand on the NE 2nd Avenue sidewalk in Crosstown facing the elevated train station and wait for the matching painted train to pull in and stop so the artwork aligns; (3) 'Extraction Service' — stand on the northwest roof corner of New Quay Plaza on SE 1st Avenue in Downtown and photograph the painted lower roof; (4) 'Compliance Theater' — take the elevator to the roof of Piker Financial Center on SE 2nd Avenue in Downtown, climb the radio tower ladder, and aim straight down; and (5) 'Privatized Pains Socialized Gains' — stand on the Barlow Street sidewalk in Ocean Beach facing the underside of the public parking garage.

Once all five optical illusions are captured, @1010 sends a follow-up message pointing to Southside Storage at the southern tip of Salton (just north of the Slator Towing Inc. yard between SW 6th Street and SW 7th Avenue). Entering keypad code 1010 permanently unlocks the 1-car Southside Storage personal garage—complete with a custom portal-painted interior—and rewards you with the classic '95 Grotti Cheetah (1010 Cheetah) wrapped in an exclusive 1010 art livery.
author: Caspahz

title: Lucia's Discarded Prologue Pistol
description: Return to the rooftop of the Little Cuba Payday Loans store from the Prologue flashback to recover Lucia's discarded handgun.
content: During the GTA 6 Prologue flashback (set nine months before Lucia's incarceration at Hamlet Correctional), Lucia holds up the MoneyShift Payday Loans store in North Little Cuba, Vice City, right across the street from Rosita's Cuban Cafe. While sprinting across the rooftops to escape the responding VCPD officers, she ditches her compact pistol before getting arrested.

Once you reach Vice City in free roam (starting in Chapter 3), you can travel back to the exact North Little Cuba block just off the Interstate 97 highway interchange and canal. Head into the rear parking lot behind the Payday Loans building and climb up onto the roof where Lucia fled during the opening sequence.

Walk toward the canal side of the rooftop and inspect the cluster of air-conditioning units: sitting directly on top of a round, trash-can-shaped cylindrical metal rooftop vent is the exact gun Lucia threw away. Picking it up permanently unlocks the Low Point Nipper .38—a gold-icon Unique Weapon Variant of the Scorpio Nipper .38 (parodying a beat-up Hi-Point pistol) complete with custom lore text—for both Lucia and Jason. As an added bonus, returning to rob this same Payday Loans shop again as Lucia after unlocking the Dye-Pack Jammer triggers unique callback dialogue and a secret achievement.
author: pi5cesmoon

title: Lucia Topless Glitch & Cut NPC Reactions
description: Use an exploit at Bargain World in Port Gellhorn to trigger hidden NPC voice lines, phone cameras, and protective fights from Jason.
content: Although Grand Theft Auto VI offers no legitimate menu option to remove all of Lucia’s upper clothing in free roam, Rockstar Games still programmed full AI states, animations, and voiced dialogue for public nudity. When walking down Vice Beach or through the city with the glitch active, pedestrians visibly do double-takes, make shocked or flirty remarks, and pull out their smartphones to record or snap photos—leading the community to conclude that a topless or nudist toggle was either cut late in development or given dedicated developer failsafe reactions.

To trigger the glitch in free roam starting in Chapter 2, head to the Bargain World thrift store in southern Port Gellhorn and buy any long denim jacket (such as the Distressed Trucker Jacket). In the changing room, equip the jacket under Jackets > Denim, switch the wear style to Style 3 (closed), and press Triangle (PS5) / Y (Xbox) on Remove Tank Top so nothing is worn underneath. Back out to Saved Outfits, save/copy this outfit (Triangle / Y), and store it in your vehicle’s trunk (Square / X).

Switch into any different outfit (such as a one-piece dress), step outside the store, and equip a Bulletproof Vest via your loadout wheel (L1 -> R1 -> Body Armor, purchased from the counter at any Gun & Pawn shop). Walk to your car’s trunk (L1 -> R1 -> Swap Outfit) and swap back to the saved denim jacket outfit so the vest overrides the jacket, leaving only the armor on Lucia’s upper body. Run back into the store’s wardrobe, change your shoes to any other pair, and save the outfit once more.

Exit into the open world and destroy your body armor—either by dropping a frag grenade nearby or taking gunfire from police—and the vest will break without reloading an underlying shirt. Beyond random beachgoers snapping photos, walking down Vice Beach holding hands with Jason causes him to angrily confront and fight male NPCs who hit on Lucia, and even story NPCs like Port Gellhorn car fence Moses Watkins have dedicated voice lines asking why she isn’t wearing clothes.
author: Cranefomo
